result.stderr:
zplcore-mcp – MCP server (stdio) for zplCore.com

Usage:
  zplcore-mcp [--workers n] [--timeout-seconds n] [--memory-mb n] [--no-os-sandbox] [--log quiet|info|debug]
              [--license <key|file>]
  zplcore-mcp --help | --version

Speaks the Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per line) on stdin/stdout; logs go to stderr.
There is no network transport. Tools accept ZPL/EPL text only and never read or write files, open network
connections, run programs or read environment variables. Every tool call runs in a separate worker process
that is killed when it exceeds the time or memory limit. Without a zplCore licence key the outputs carry the
evaluation watermark.

  --workers n           parallel worker processes, 1-8 (default 2)
  --timeout-seconds n   wall-clock limit per tool call, 1-120 (default 20)
  --memory-mb n         memory limit per worker, 256-8192 (default 1536)
  --no-os-sandbox       macOS: do not run workers under sandbox-exec (no network, no file writes)
  --log level           stderr logging (default info; tool input is never logged)
  --license key|file    zplCore licence key, or a file that contains it (else ZPLCORE_LICENSE,
                        ZPLCORE_LICENSE_FILE or zplcore.license next to the server); checked offline
